name: Download job logs for a workflow run
description: Download job logs for a workflow run Gets a redirect URL to download a plain text file of logs for a workflow job. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs
Gets a redirect URL to download a plain text file of logs for a workflow job. This link expires after 1 minute. Look for `Location:` in the response header to find the URL for the download. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; job_id (path) — The unique identifier of the job.

name: Get a job for a workflow run
description: Get a job for a workflow run Gets a specific job in a workflow run. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}

name: Re-run a job from a workflow run
description: Re-run a job from a workflow run Re-run a job and its dependent jobs in a workflow run. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/rerun
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/rerun
Re-run a job and its dependent jobs in a workflow run. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; job_id (path) — The unique identifier of the job.
Optional: body (body)
